## Software

- [R](https://www.r-project.org/) for statistical computing.
- [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) for writing and running R.
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) for reproducible documents and this course site.

## R packages

Install the course packages from R with:

```r
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "tidymodels", "infer", "janitor"))
```

## References

- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)
- [OpenIntro Statistics](https://www.openintro.org/book/os/)
- [Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/)

## Getting help

Bring questions to class or office hours. When asking for programming help, include the code you ran, the full error message, and a small sample of the data when possible.
